instruction: Could you flip this video horizontally and save the result as 'Apple_Commercial_Mirrored.mp4' to the Desktop?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires horizontally flipping a video in VLC and saving it. Evaluator verifies horizontal flip by checking: 1) file existence and correct filename, 2) video dimensions remain unchanged (horizontal flip preserves width x height, unlike rotation), 3) CRITICAL pixel-level verification: extracts left and right edge columns from both source and output videos, verifies that source's left edge matches output's right edge and vice versa (proving horizontal flip was applied). This method specifically detects horizontal flip and cannot be fooled by other transformations like brightness, contrast, or color adjustments.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies horizontal flip via edge pixel swapping analysis
Getter extracts left and right edge columns (10 pixels wide) from both source and output videos at frames 0 and 30, computes MD5 hashes of raw RGB pixel data
Metric verifies horizontal flip by checking: source_left_hash == output_right_hash AND source_right_hash == output_left_hash (vlc.py metric lines 198-232)
This verification method is specific to horizontal flip and cannot be fooled by other transformations (brightness, contrast, color adjustments, etc.) - only edge swapping will pass
Complete coverage: checks file existence, correct filename, video validity, dimension preservation, and pixel-level horizontal flip verification
Logic is robust: tests two frames (0 and 30) for consistency, uses exact pixel comparison via MD5 hashes of raw RGB data
